findings: The live Pennsylvania DEP GreenPort production-report description supports reporting-period and operator/permit filters, CSV export and operator-reported data. The quoted 13-selection constraint is an interface rule, not a royalty reporting or payment rule.

DEP's dated 2023 annual account supports monthly unconventional natural-gas reporting and annual conventional production reporting. The article attributes cadence to that account and makes no current deadline or owner-payment diagnosis.

DEP's laws-and-regulations page explicitly says the Commonwealth does not regulate private mineral-owner/producer leases and DEP does not audit payments. The article does not infer that no private remedy exists.
DEP's mapping description supplies possible permit/operator and location leads with locational-data limits, not tract or lease coverage. No particular map point or owner file was assessed.

The version 1.8, April 7 2022 DEP report data dictionary describes operator-submitted gas, condensate and oil and cautions about accuracy, completeness and timeliness. Current CSV fields were not inspected and are not claimed; the article instructs readers to confirm labels in a current export.
